$comment: Judgment, not evidence: which S2A token plays the same role as a Spectrum token. token-map.mjs reads this; it never writes it. Equal colour values do not imply equal roles, so a colour only aliases through a row here. A row aliases when the light values match, or when `decided` says whose value wins ('ours' takes the S2A token; 'theirs' keeps Spectrum's literal). Seeded from docs/references/s2-vs-s2a-tokens.md.

--swc-background-layer-2-color.why: Second layer; white in both systems.

--swc-disabled-border-color.why: Disabled border; one ramp step apart.

--swc-disabled-background-color.why: Disabled fill; two ramp steps apart.

--swc-focus-indicator-color.why: Focus ring; one ramp step apart.

--swc-neutral-content-color-default.why: Default text: gray-800 there, black here. On the board as the text colour decision.

--swc-neutral-background-color-default.why: The neutral fill is what a primary action wears here.

--swc-opacity-disabled.why: 0.3 there, 0.48 here. On the board as the disabled decision.

--swc-avatar-opacity-disabled.why: Same decision as the global disabled opacity.

--swc-overlay-opacity-light.why: Scrim, light. On the board as the scrim decision.

--swc-sans-font-family-stack.why: Body family: Adobe Clean Spectrum VF there, Adobe Clean here.

--swc-corner-radius-full.why: The pill: 50% there draws an ellipse on anything not square, 999px here does not.
